lines.en: I hang beneath the leaf tip, swinging.
This shell of mine has no legs.
When the wind comes, I turn with it.
I'm wedged between two thin twigs.
My thread wraps the leaf stem once.
I only move when the leaf moves.
The twig sways, and I rock with it.
The wind has lifted me higher.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地偏向有光那边。
lines.en: I drift slowly toward the light.
I hang a bit higher than my kin.
The leaf presses against my shell.

lines.zh: 我什么也做不了，只能挂。
lines.en: There's nothing I can do but hang.
I traced half an arc in the air.

lines.zh: 我又回到了原来的角度。
lines.en: I've come back to the same angle.
The wind stops, and so do I.

lines.zh: 一整天我只动了这一点点。
lines.en: That was all the movement I had all day.
I'm as quiet as a piece of fruit.
Fine lines run over my shell.
I'm waiting for this body to finish.
It's getting crowded inside the shell.
I hear a bird hopping in the tree.
I'm brighter than I was yesterday.
I hang at the end of a vein.

lines.zh: 我的丝是唯一连着外面。
lines.en: The thread is all that connects me.

lines.zh: 我数着光暗交替的次数。
lines.en: I count the shifts from light to dark.

lines.zh: 化蛹以后，我连饿都忘了。
lines.en: Since pupating, I've forgotten hunger.
My shell has gotten thinner.
Something out there is chewing another leaf.

lines.zh: 你从下面看我，倒过来了。
lines.en: You're looking at me upside down.
I'm high up; keep your hands away.

lines.zh: 你挡住光了，我倒不在意。
lines.en: You're blocking the light, but I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我只是个挂在叶下的壳。
lines.en: I'm just a shell hanging under a leaf.
Look a little more carefully.

lines.zh: 里面的东西快要出来了。
lines.en: What's inside is nearly out.
Can you count the lines?
I'm bluer than the other chrysalises.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸碰到了我的丝。
lines.en: Your breath is touching my thread.
You needn't pick me off.

lines.zh: 壳面被擦掉一层，露出浅色。
lines.en: A layer is scraped off, showing pale shell beneath.
I pause a moment inside.
My thread has stretched a little.

lines.zh: 我吊在丝上，摆了半天才定。
lines.en: I dangle from the thread, swaying a long while before settling.
Something inside the shell has shifted.
I'm tighter than I was a moment ago.
I don't dare struggle again.
That's plenty for something like me.
I'm hanging slightly askew.
I can only hope it leaves.
I don't want to move a finger.
There's no mouth in use in this shell.
Food is for caterpillars.
Just put the leaf down.
I'm not eating during this stretch.
You're talking to an empty-looking shell.
I can taste nothing.
Put it back, and don't shake my branch.

lines.zh: 留着喂树下那些嘴馋的。
lines.en: Save it for the hungry ones under the tree.
Feed it to the other bugs.
You touched the branch and I swung.
My thread went taut.
My shell hit the vein.
I swung back again.

lines.zh: 枝叶一弯，我擦到了另一片叶。
lines.en: The twig bent and I grazed another leaf.
I turned half a circle in the air.
You stepped back and the branch settled.
My thread has gone a bit slack.

lines.zh: 我被撞得摆来摆去，丝却没断。
lines.en: The hit sets me swinging, but the thread holds.
A white spot appeared on my shell.
Another one hangs above me.
It's closer to the leaf than I am.
Neither of us can move.

lines.zh: 它的壳上有一道纹更深。
lines.en: One line on its shell is deeper.
The wind leans us to the same side.

lines.zh: 它先出来的话，我也知道。
lines.en: If it emerges first, I'll know.
We share the same twig.
We hang here and wait.
In a few days it won't be here.
Only leaf shadow passes between us.
I can't touch anything.

lines.zh: 地上掉了一片叶，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see a leaf fall, nothing more.
My limbs are all inside the shell.

lines.zh: 一片碎叶卡在我的丝上。
lines.en: A leaf scrap is caught on my thread.

lines.zh: 我只能记下它掉的位置。
lines.en: All I can do is note where it fell.
My shell catches the wind for me.

lines.zh: 这点重量不足以拉动我。
lines.en: That weight isn't enough to pull me.

lines.zh: 它落在下面的草丛里了。
lines.en: It landed in the grass below.
I see it, and can't take it.
When the wind comes, the leaf will move.
Footsteps are coming along the branch.
I hang here, unable to run.
The light has been blocked.
I hear someone looking up.
I can't move at all.
My shell is still soft.

lines.zh: 我屏住里面所有的动作。
lines.en: I still everything inside.
The shadow has come close.

lines.zh: 我没有退路，只有这根丝。
lines.en: No retreat for me; only this thread.
If I can just last this out.
My shadow is small and faint.
You can't hear what's in the shell.
My joints are still soft.
You've taken one step closer.
I hold fast to the thread.
I don't dare let the shell rattle.

lines.zh: 你的手在叶边停了又停。
lines.en: Your hand keeps pausing at the leaf's edge.
This tree has gone a little too quiet.

lines.zh: 我挂在你能碰到的地方。
lines.en: I'm hanging within your reach.
I have no other way.
I'm a hard shell; I can't move.
I can only let the leaf swing me into it.
That had almost no weight.
My shell knocked against its hand.
I strained once inside the shell.
This isn't something I can do.

lines.zh: 我完全没有还手的办法。
lines.en: I have no way at all to strike back.
A line was scored across the shell.
I draw to the very center.
I swung back to where I was.
I formed this shell under a leaf.

lines.zh: 我把自己挂在这根枝上。
lines.en: I hung myself from this twig.
The light here isn't too strong.

lines.zh: 我的丝还带着一点湿意。
lines.en: My thread still feels a little wet.

lines.zh: 我选了个没人碰的地方。
lines.en: I picked a spot nothing touches.
The forest wind comes up from below.

lines.zh: 我的颜色淡得几乎透明。
lines.en: My color is pale, almost clear.
I'm folded into this shape.

lines.zh: 外面的一切都慢下来了。
lines.en: Everything outside has slowed.
I settle in to wait.
The heat has made my shell hot to the touch.
I fell and landed on fallen leaves.
Rain gets inside the shell and I hang heavy.
The blast throws the branch up.
An arrow tip scours my shell.
Magic coats me and the shell hardens.
I've fasted so long there's nothing left inside.
Lightning shines right through the tree.
There's no branch to hang from here.
